name: Mailchimp
summary: This guide describes how to set up an OAuth2 application for the Mailchimp Marketing API. You will register your own application with Mailchimp to obtain a client ID and secret, configure a redirect URI, and implement the OAuth2 authorization flow on your own server using technologies such as TypeScript, PHP, or Ruby.
decision: Follow the process to register your own application in your Mailchimp account, obtain your unique client ID and secret, set a redirect URI, and implement the OAuth2 flow on your own server as described in the provider documentation. There is no evidence that Mailchimp offers a managed app or that you may skip manual configuration.

steps.title: Register your application
steps.body: 1. Navigate to the Registered Apps page in your Mailchimp account (https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/oauth2/). 2. Click 'Register An App'. 3. Fill out the 'Register An App' form with your details. 4. Click 'Create' to receive your client_id and client_secret.
steps.note: The citation is not an official documentation host.

steps.title: Copy and securely store your client_secret
steps.body: This is the only time you'll be able to see client_secret, so you need to copy it and store it securely.
steps.note: The citation is not an official documentation host.

steps.title: Implement the OAuth2 flow on your server
steps.body: Write server code to: - Start the OAuth2 process by redirecting users to Mailchimp's authorize endpoint. - Handle the callback from Mailchimp with the authorization code. - Exchange the code for an access token with a POST request to https://login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/token. - Store and use the access token to make authenticated API requests.
